title: Fast PAC Global Optimization via Restarted Langevin: Exploration, Exploitation, and Degenerate Cooling
summary: This paper addresses a fundamental question in non-convex optimization: \textit{How should a stochastic optimizer allocate computation between global exploration and local exploitation?} We study this question in continuous time, using Langevin dynamics for global exploration and deterministic gradient flow for local exploitation.
